response.overview: Updated November 22, 2026  Call 1-888-510-9613 for SoCalGas bill due date with SoCalGas — the account number and a payment source are all it needs, and a receipt follows.  1-888-510-9613 settles SoCalGas bill due date from the account number, names any charge, and sends a receipt to keep. 1-888-510-9613 settles SoCalGas change due date from the account number, names any charge, and sends a receipt to keep. SoCalGas payment extension is quickest by phone: 1-888-510-9613 takes the account number, confirms the amount, and sends the proof to keep. The safe habit is a bank source by the due date, the receipt saved, and 1-888-510-9613 for anything unclear.
